name: Apache HTTP Server
description: Workers, requests and traffic from mod_status
hint: Enable mod_status (a2enmod status) and allow /server-status from localhost. Add “ExtendedStatus On” for request and traffic counters. Needs curl or wget.
command: if command -v curl >/dev/null; then curl -fsS --max-time 5 ${status_url}; else wget -qO- -T 5 ${status_url}; fi
